messages:
PagerDutyBot: INCIDENT ALERT - hosted-api: GPU pool exhausted in us-east-1. Queue length rising rapidly (>120k requests). Error spike: 500s and client timeouts. Paging SRE rotation.
Maya (oncall): ack, I'm the primary oncall, joining. Looking at console now.
Priya (sre): joining. I can see p95 jump on /v1/generate to ~3.2s and p99 to ~11.7s across the region. Queue size is still growing.
Maya (oncall): Autoscaler logs show repeated failures to create nodes. OpsBot, paste recent error?
OpsBot: ``ERROR autoscaler: scale_up failed status=403 reason=QuotaExceeded region=us-east-1 resource=GPU-accelerator``
Eve (eng): we just hit a hard quota from the cloud account. Requests are being accepted by the gateway but there are no healthy GPU backends. Fallback isn't routing yet.
Priya (sre): Confirmed. ETA on human quota uplift is unknown. We should enable fallback routing to compatible model-variant immediately and reduce token limits where appropriate.
Maya (oncall): Steps I'll run now: 1) enable canary fallback route (20%) to quantized-gpt-small, 2) lower max_tokens to 512 for non-critical tenants, 3) enable prefix caching for eligible routes. Anyone object?
Jalen (infra): go ahead. Also I'm kicking off a manual pool creation against our spare subscription (different quota) as a hotfix. Might take ~8-12m to bootstrap.
Carlos (support): Notifying top tier enterprise customers that might be impacted. I'll send templated note and list which endpoints affected.
Eve (eng): Adding the routing rule: ``/v1/generate -> weight(quantized-gpt-small:20, main-prod-model:80)`` pushed. Monitoring A/B now.
Priya (sre): Patch applied. Early telemetry: queue growth rate slowed ~40% after fallback. Errors still ~3% for in-flight requests.
Maya (oncall): Started reducing allowed concurrency per API key for non-paid tiers: threshold from 50 -> 10. Will reduce load further.
OpsBot: New log excerpts: ``2026-03-15T02:11:03Z autoscaler: create_instance failed - 403 QuotaExceeded``
Priya (sre): Also seeing cascade: internal queuer's eviction loop is trying to kill and resurrect tasks, producing spikes in latency. Turning eviction aggressiveness down now.
Eve (eng): Manual pool create succeeded in spare-subscription. Spinning up 12 GPUs and attaching to hosted routing pool. Will take a couple minutes to warm up kv caches.
Maya (oncall): Good. After we attach those nodes, route 25% traffic to them and gaslight? (typo) I mean, gracefully shift.
Jalen (infra): attaching pool -> done. Health checks passing. Warmup tokens in progress.
Priya (sre): Observability: p95 dropped to ~1.1s on canary, global p95 now ~1.8s, p99 trending down from 11s to 4.5s. Queue length decreasing steadily.
Carlos (support): Initial customer impact assessment: ~18 enterprise tenants saw increased latency >2s for 7-25 minutes. Two customers reported request timeouts and opened support cases. Sharing notes in customer-status channel.
Maya (oncall): Summarizing mitigation so far:
- Enabled 20% fallback routing to quantized model
- Throttled non-paying tier concurrency and lowered max_tokens
- Disabled aggressive eviction in queuer
- Manually provisioned spare-subscription GPU pool and shifted 25% of traffic
- Notified customers and support queued responses
These actions brought queue and p99 down.
Eve (eng): Autoscaler still reporting quota errors to cloud. We should escalate quota increase request with cloud support and open a follow-up with Finance to request permanent quota bump.
Priya (sre): Agreed — raised cloud support ticket #CS-98764 and added urgency. Also created internal issue to add autoscaler fallback (on QuotaExceeded) to automatically route traffic to spare pools in future.
Maya (oncall): Preparing a handoff to night oncall (Jalen). Key items for next shift:
- Watch autoscaler errors: any further 403s mean we need to keep manual pool up or route more to quantized model.
- Validate that the cloud quota case progresses before autoscaler tries more scale-ups.
- Follow up on customer support cases; ensure postmortem comms ready.
Jalen (infra): Taking over. I've documented runbook steps in the thread pinned message and will be available for the next hour for questions.
Maya (oncall): Quick post-incident notes for postmortem: probable root causes: sudden inbound traffic spike from a third-party integration + autoscaler did not have spare capacity fallback when quota exhausted. Action items:
- Add autoscaler policy: on QuotaExceeded -> pause scale attempts, increase fallback routing to smaller variants, and attempt alternative subscription pools.
- Add alert that triggers earlier (queue > 10k) with immediate rate limiting thresholds.
- Improve warmup for manual pools so KV caches are prepopulated faster.
Carlos (support): Customer impact log saved to incident ticket. Will prepare a customer-facing summary once we have postmortem.
Priya (sre): Marking incident as mitigated at 2026-03-15T02:22:30Z. Will keep monitoring for 60m.
OpsBot: INCIDENT UPDATE posted to #status with current metrics.
Jalen (infra): A few follow-ups assigned to me and Eve. I'll keep the spare pool up until quota confirmation. Handoff complete.
Maya (oncall): Thanks everyone. If anything regresses ping me.
Eve (eng): Good job team. We'll loop in product for rate-limit/plan thresholds to reduce blast radius.
Carlos (support): Closing immediate support actions; leaving customer cases open until we confirm no replay errors.
Priya (sre): last note: captured heap of logs and uploaded to incident archive: s3://redwood-incidents/2654321987/logs.tar.gz
Maya (oncall): logging the incident for retrospective. End thread.
